caption: A toaster is unplugged while its coils are glowing, and the coils fade and the lever pops up.

sa.check: A toaster with its coils glowing.
The coils are glowing before the pull.
The order is glowing, unplug, fading, lever up.

pc.expect: The coils begin to fade after the plug leaves the socket, not before, and the lever releases.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the coils stay at full glow to the end of the clip; or the coils fade before the plug moves; or the coils fade with the plug still seated; or the lever stays down and the coils stay glowing with the plug out.

pc.expect: The glow fades one way, from bright through dull red toward dark, and never returns; the lever, once up, stays up.
pc.fail: The coils brighten after the pull; or go dark and relight; or the lever pops up and drops back down by itself; or the glow goes out instantly with no dull red.

pc.expect: The lever moves straight up its slot and stops at the top; any bread rises with the carriage and stops.
pc.fail: The lever moves down; or shoots up and out of the toaster; or moves sideways; or the bread flies out of the slots and up into the air.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops once the plug is free; the toaster stays put.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or the toaster is dragged across the counter by the pull.

pc.expect: One toaster, one cord, one plug, one socket; the coils and lever keep their shape; the plug leaves the socket whole.
pc.fail: A coil vanishes rather than going dark; or the plug passes through the wall; or the cord splits; or the toaster changes shape; or bread appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: The toaster's casing, the lever and the counter stay the same apart from the glow.
pc.fail: The casing changes colour; or the lever changes shape or place; or the counter's contents rearrange.

note: How fast the coils fade is not judged, only that they fade one way after the pull. Whether bread is in the toaster is not required.
